text: Subjective: 72-year-old with known COPD presents with increased cough, wheezing, and shortness of breath over 3 days. Still smoking half a pack per day. Objective: Diffuse wheezes on exam, oxygen saturation 90% on room air, mild tachypnea. Chest X-ray without focal consolidation. Plan: Start short course of oral steroids, increase use of rescue inhaler, add nebulized bronchodilators, counsel on smoking cessation and arrange close follow-up.
